VR.title: Meta is Spinning out ‘Supernatural’ a Mere 3 Years After $400M Acquisition
VR.summary: Meta has spun out the VR fitness app Supernatural into an independent company, Supernatural Health, reuniting its original founders and coaches.

VR.title: Supernatural To Return Under New Independent Company As Coaches Rejoin Platform
VR.summary: Supernatural is set to return as an independent entity after Meta hands back the IP to its original creators.

VR.summary: Two Quest 3 headsets will be sent to the International Space Station to assist astronauts in training for spacewalks.

VR.summary: X-Plane 12 and iRacing are now playable in VR on Apple Vision Pro, streamed from PC with physical accessories integrated.

VR.summary: Beat Saber celebrates its 8th anniversary by releasing three new free songs for players on Quest and SteamVR.

AI.summary: TSMC is struggling to meet surging AI demand, with CEO C.C. Wei stating they can only support limited capacity.
